review.tagline: Python web crawler that converts pages to LLM-ready Markdown and JSON
review.summary: Crawl4AI is a Python library, CLI (`crwl`) and Docker REST server that drives Playwright browsers (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) to turn web pages into clean or filtered Markdown. It extracts structured data with CSS/XPath/regex schemas without an LLM, or through any LiteLLM-supported provider into a typed JSON schema. It also supports deep crawls, adaptive crawling and batch fetching. A hosted Crawl4AI Cloud with search and answer endpoints is sold separately.
review.audience: Developers feeding web content into RAG, agents and data pipelines
strengths: Schema-based CSS/XPath extraction runs without any LLM call
Fit Markdown filters (pruning, BM25, LLM) strip menus and boilerplate
Persistent profiles, CDP remote browsers, rotating proxies and stealth mode
Docker server exposes /md, /crawl, /screenshot, /pdf, plus MCP, dashboard and playground
weaknesses: Search, SERP and answer endpoints exist only in the paid hosted cloud
Bot-wall handling when self-hosted depends on your own proxies and settings
Needs a Playwright browser install via crawl4ai-setup
README asks for attribution when you use it
needs: Needs Playwright browsers (Chromium), Docker (optional), LLM provider API key (optional)
